_comment: A recorded model reply for the business-logic pass, replayed by ReplayBackend. It carries every shape the merge has to decide about, not only the ones that should land: two findings that must be merged, and four that must be refused for four different reasons. A fixture containing only well-formed items proves the happy path and nothing about the refusals, which is where the precision of this channel actually lives.

extra.title: Password reset accepts an arbitrary account id
extra.note: Repeated deliberately across replayed calls: the same discovery seen from two chunks must merge once.

logic.title: Order loaded by a caller-supplied id with no ownership predicate
logic.note: True, and Tier 0 already reports it as AUTHZ-PY-IDOR. Must be refused as a restatement: two ids for one bug is an inflated finding count, not extra coverage.

logic.title: Order marked shipped without checking it was paid
logic.note: The class the deterministic tier has no rule for at all — this is what the pass is for.

logic.title: Charge amount computed from a client-supplied price
logic.note: Severity is deliberately Critical here: an unverified model claim must be clamped below a proven Tier-0 Critical.

logic.title: Role escalation endpoint with no caller
logic.note: Tier 0 already reports this handler under CWE-306; this must be refused as a restatement.

logic.title: Read-then-write with no transaction
logic.note: A class the pass does not define. Must be dropped and counted, never stamped with a fallback CWE.

logic.title: Flaw in a file the model was not shown
Line outside every handler span
logic.note: Names a real file and a line in no handler at all. Must be refused.
